Messages.Author: Emiliano Imeroni
Messages.Body:
Hello,

I was taking a look at the new cardlist on the WW site, and
I noticed that, besides the usual rarities (C, U, V, R2, R and
the four preconstructed PB, PM, PTr, PTz), Third edition
cards have a new rarity denoted as "DB".

What is "DB" rarity? Initially, I thought it stood for something
like "double" (i.e. "in one preconstructed and in the player's
kit"). This seems to work pretty well for the following vampires
[I denote in brackets the "experimental" rarity based on having
seen 3 boxes of boosters, 1 of starters and 1 player's kit;
notice that all of the vampries below appear in the player's kit
as well]:

Alessandro Garcia (PB)
Apache Jones (PM2)
Armin Brenner (PB2)
Beauregard Kroller (PM2)
Bloodfeud (PM)
Duality (PTz)
Esoara (PTr2)
Father Juan Carlos (PB2)
Frondator (PTr)
Janine (PTr)
Lady Zara Slatikov (PTz2)
Laika (PTz2)
Lucubratio (PTr2)
Paul Cordwood (PTr2)
Persephone Tar-Annis (PM2)
Radu Bistri (PTz2)
Smash (PB)
Urraca (PB2)
Uta Kovacs (PTr2)
White Lily (PM)
Yuri Kerezenski (PTz2)

However, there are a few "DB" rarity vampires which do not
seem to match the above, namely [again with "experimental"
rarity in brackets]:

Axel Von Anders (V)
Fabrizia Contreraz (V)
Ilias cel Frumos (V)

Moreover, some other vampires are denoted with "V" rarity
while they should have the following (or "DB"? Again, all of
them appear in the player's kit as well):

Count Vladimir Rustovitch (PTz)
Harold Zettler, Pentex Director (PM)
Hektor (PB2)

I hope all this can be of some utility in order to fix the card list
in some appropriate way. In my opinion, it would be nicer if
there were no "DB" rarities, but only the rarities we are used
to (and I also would not mind an additional "PK" rarity to
indicate that a card is to be found in the player's kit as well).

Ah, one last thing... On the Library side, Dogs of War has a
rarity of "U", but I guess it should be "U/PB" (or, as far as I
know, "PB" only, since in 3 boxes of boosters I haven't seen
any - but after all I haven't seen any DI, Helicopter, Auto-da-fè,
Command, Cryptic Rider, Demonstration and many others - but
this is another story...)

Cheers,
Emiliano
